portInfo.description: Bar is Montenegro’s main commercial port city. Port of Adria frames cruise development from a first call in 2014 and notes acceptance of vessels over 300 m with further capacity for development. Bar Cruise Port publishes passenger-facing destination and port information with address Obala 13. jula. Luka Bar’s passenger terminal page describes specialisation in passenger and ro-pax ships with water depth up to 5.9 m. Because 5.9 m conflicts with “over 300 m ships” marketing unless different berths are meant, this guide quotes both and leaves reconciliation as a GAP.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Bar Cruise Port / Port of Bar passenger terminal — Obala 13. jula, 85000 Bar, Montenegro

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask which berth depth applies to your ship given the 5.9 m passenger-page note vs >300 m marketing.
